entries.en: Set `CLAUDE_BASH_NO_LOGIN` environment variable to 1 or true to to skip login shell for BashTool
entries.zh: 将 `CLAUDE_BASH_NO_LOGIN` 环境变量设为 1 或 true，可让 BashTool 跳过登录 shell

entries.en: No longer inform Claude of the list of allowed tools when permission is denied
entries.zh: 权限被拒绝时，不再把允许的工具列表告知 Claude

entries.en: Improved VSCode extension performance for large files
entries.zh: 改进 VS Code 扩展处理大文件时的性能

entries.en: Fix Bedrock and Vertex environment variables evaluating all strings as truthy
entries.zh: 修复 Bedrock 和 Vertex 环境变量，将所有字符串评估为 true

entries.en: Fixed security vulnerability in Bash tool permission checks
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 工具权限检查中的安全漏洞
